text:
cory: Quick sketch for an experiment I discussed with PM — 'prompt ladder' drip + credit ladder for power users. Target: creators who used prompt templates once but never returned. Goal: nudge them to build and save a prompt within 7 days.

mai: Nice. Who do we count as 'power users'?

cory: Segment = users with >=5 edits to prompts OR >=50 tokens in a single session but no saved prompt. Also include those who opened the prompt templates modal twice.

rachel: Proposed arms: control, low-credit (50 tokens), ladder-credit (50 now + 50 if they save a prompt), ladder+templates (same ladder + personalized 3-template pack).

tom: Timeline and sample size? We need enough to detect ~5pp lift. With current traffic maybe 3 weeks.

mai: Implementation flags: in-console banner + email + optional Slack/Teams webhook if integrated. In-console should show suggested template based on last prompt category. Personalization = derive top intent from recent prompts.

product-bot: Experiment stub created: id=exp-2026-04-prompt-ladder, arms=4, start=1772510000, end=1772710000. Logged to #growth-experiments.

rachel: Analytics: primary = saved_prompt within 7d. Secondary = calls to generation endpoint after save, # of distinct templates tried. Add event `prompt_template_suggested` with `variant` metadata.

mai: Microcopy ideas for banner: 1) "Try these prompts — 50 free tokens to get started." 2) "Saved prompt = more tokens. Build once, reuse forever." Will post copy variants. :memo:

emma-sales: For leads: if an org gets >=3 users saving prompts and collective token usage > 2k within 72h, escalate to Sales as warm lead with `reason=prompt-ladder` and `hot=true`. Include `top_use_case` field.

cory: Edge cases: existing credits, partner promos, or enterprise customers on contract. Exclude orgs with `promo_recent=true` or `billing_state=enterprise`. Also avoid double-grant if user already in another experiment.

mai: Backend plan: reuse /exp/grant endpoint with payload:
```
POST /exp/grant
{
  "user_id": "U888",
  "exp_id": "exp-2026-04-prompt-ladder",
  "arm": "ladder+templates",
  "credits": 50,
  "templates": ["support-bot", "meeting-summarizer", "bug-triage"]
}
```
We will return a promo_code if grant fails so email fallback works. Add idempotency key = `exp_grant_<user>_<exp>`.

rachel: Measurement: run weekly lift calc and then a full analysis after 2 weeks. Compute ARR-equivalent LTV from incremental activations to estimate ROI. Also report CPU/GPU token costs for the uplift.

emma-sales: SDR sequence: 24h follow-up email for users who saved prompt but low activity, 72h reach for orgs with 3+ saves. Add sample subject lines: "Loved your prompt — want help scaling?" and "See what Redwood can do for X use case".

cory: Creative assets: small carousel of 3 templates with one-click "save". Need figma mock + PNGs. Can design team deliver in 48h?

mai: I'll own the banner & email. Can we A/B test CTA text: "Save and get more tokens" vs "Try this template".

product-bot: Guardrail rule suggestion: if redemption rate > 20% and cost exceeds daily spend cap, pause rollout automatically. Add `daily_experiment_spend_cap` param.

rachel: Also exclude users with `sso_enforced=true` where we can't show in-app banner.

cory: UX flow for ladder: user receives 50 tokens + banner. If they save a prompt within 48h, auto-credit additional 50 tokens and show a confetti microinteraction. If not, send a reminder email at 24h.

mai: Email variants: Subject A = "50 free tokens to save your first prompt" Subject B = "We saved a template for you — claim tokens" Body short + CTA + one-screenshot. I'll post drafts.

emma-sales: For routing efficiency, include `org_mrr_band` in webhook so SDRs can prioritize. Also add `recent_activity_score`.

cory: Can we add a lightweight survey on the post-save modal: one question "What's your main use case?" with options. That will feed `top_use_case` signal.

rachel: Good idea. Use that to weight lead scoring. We'll also log template category to evaluate which templates drive adoption.

mai: Anything else? I'll schedule a QA slot with eng for the grant flow and a data QA with analytics.

product-bot: QA checklist: grant endpoint tested, idempotency verified, events emitted with `exp_id`, UI variant mapped, email triggered, fallback promo code path.

cory: Cool. Aim to start rollout in 10 days. Check-in next Tue. Tagging @mai @rachel @tom @emma-sales. :rocket:
